brief:
Gaza's Health Ministry issued an epidemiological alert over rising meningitis cases linked to environmental degradation across the territory, the Ma'an news agency reported. The warning signals growing health risks as sanitation infrastructure continues to deteriorate.

Meningitis cases have increased as waste management systems fail and water contamination persists throughout Gaza. The Health Ministry connected the disease spread to the broader collapse of environmental conditions in the territory.
title: Health Ministry warns of meningitis surge amid Gaza environmental collapse
